name: Rime's Wrath

angles.text: Shamans recognize the danger posed by unbridled elementals like Avala, whose turbulent presence warps the local weather and shakes the stone. Quelling such agitated beings is vital to restoring harmony between the elements.

Paladins uphold the duty of protecting travelers and vulnerable commoners from sudden catastrophes. The questgiver invokes the Light's blessing upon the quest's completion in gratitude for averting unnecessary deaths.

faq.answer: Rime's Wrath is a quest tasking adventurers with eliminating Avala, a large and hazardous elemental that manifested following a sudden rockslide. By hunting down the elemental and recovering its core, adventurers put an end to the erratic weather disturbances and recurring slides threatening travelers across the mountain pass.

Avala is a particularly large elemental that surfaced in the aftermath of a major rockslide. Larger than its elemental peers, Avala actively causes sudden weather changes, freezing chills, and dangerous secondary earth tremors in the area. The name 'Avala' was given to it by the observer monitoring the pass.

Avala's continuous presence causes unpredictable weather disruptions and minor rockslides that destabilize the surrounding slopes. Left unchecked, the elemental's supernatural influence over the winter climate and terrain threatens to trigger further collapses and cause avoidable deaths among travelers traversing the mountain pass.
faq.q: Why does Avala need to be destroyed?

faq.answer: Adventurers must retrieve the core of Avala after defeating the creature in combat. Presenting this elemental core to the questgiver confirms that the threat has been thoroughly eliminated and the regional climate can return to normal.
faq.q: What proof is needed to complete Rime's Wrath?

faq.answer: Avala emerged following an initial rockslide that disrupted the region. It appeared alongside other elementals in the aftermath of the collapse, quickly establishing itself as the most prominent and dangerous creature among them due to its size and elemental power.

The quest is offered by a local observer stationed near the hazardous mountain pass who closely monitored the rockslide and the emergence of the elementals. Invoking the blessing of the Holy Light upon completion, this watcher seeks to prevent unnecessary deaths by contracting capable champions to eliminate Avala.
faq.q: Who offers the quest Rime's Wrath?

faq.answer: Once Avala is slain and its core returned, the severe weather swings and localized tremors triggered by the creature's presence diminish. The questgiver bestows a blessing of the Light and a reward, noting that the area has been made significantly safer for future travelers.
faq.q: What happens after Avala is defeated?

sections.body: The disturbances began when a sudden rockslide destabilized the mountain pass, opening the way for elemental activity. Among the creatures that surfaced, one particular elemental stood out, towering over its kin in sheer size and raw power. Given the informal moniker "Avala" by the watchful questgiver, this potent entity is not merely an imposing presence—it directly fuels localized atmospheric turmoil and destabilizes the surrounding cliffs. Its presence poses an immediate peril to anyone attempting to navigate the area, as unstable earth and sudden winter chills make ordinary travel lethal.
sections.title: The Wake of the Rockslide

sections.body: Recognizing the escalating danger of Avala's influence over the terrain, a call was put forth to eliminate the beast before further collapses claimed lives. Slaying the creature requires facing both its elemental ferocity and the harsh conditions it generates, culminating in the recovery of its core as definitive proof of its demise. With Avala vanquished and its animating heart secured, the violent weather shifts subside, restoring a measure of safety to the surrounding mountain passes and safeguarding future travelers from needless catastrophe.
sections.title: Quelling Avala

summary: Following a rockslide, an unusually large elemental named Avala emerged and began triggering erratic weather swings and secondary landslides. An observer tasks adventurers with hunting down the elemental and claiming its core to secure the area. Defeating the creature restores stability to the mountain slopes and safeguards travelers from deadly winter perils.
